question: Find the value of 57 ^ {- 8} div 57 ^ {17 } times 57 ^ {- 18}.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For operations on the same base, subtract exponents for division and add exponents for multiplication.

Expression = 57−⁸ − ¹⁷ ⁺ ⁽−¹⁸⁾

⇒ 57−²⁵ − ¹⁸

⇒ 57−⁴³

**∴ The correct answer is 57−⁴³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = 57−⁸ ÷ 57¹⁷ × 57−¹⁸

**Formula Used:**

am ÷ aⁿ = am − ⁿ

am × aⁿ = am ⁺ ⁿ

**Calculation:**

According to the BODMAS rule, evaluate the expression from left to right for multiplication and division:

⇒ (57−⁸ ÷ 57¹⁷) × 57−¹⁸

⇒ 57−⁸ − ¹⁷ × 57−¹⁸

⇒ 57−²⁵ × 57−¹⁸

⇒ 57−²⁵ ⁺ ⁽−¹⁸⁾

⇒ 57−⁴³

**∴ The correct answer is 57−⁴³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Negative Exponents

A negative exponent means taking the reciprocal of the base: a−ⁿ = 1 ÷ aⁿ

Power of a Power Rule

When raising a power to another power, multiply the exponents: (am)ⁿ = am × ⁿ

Zero Exponent Rule

Any non-zero number raised to the power of zero is always equal to 1: a⁰ = 1
